# VORTURA.ai

> Websites and AI automations for local businesses — fast sites, missed-call text-backs, AI voice agents, review automation, and done-for-you growth systems.

VORTURA.ai is a digital agency built for small, local service businesses (plumbers, med-spas, roofing crews, clinics, trades). We ship fast, mobile-first websites paired with AI automations that answer after-hours calls, text back missed callers, request reviews, and keep leads from going cold. Every package includes onboarding, ongoing site care, and real human support.
